checkpoints.description: HUD polish verified: RANGE SCALE fully visible, six chips unclipped, Focus title retains Battle Focus; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-hud-polish' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: make reactor doctrine presets the default onboarding path and tuck manual sliders behind FINE TUNE

impact_assessment.why: The always-visible reactor strip shows four sliders, four doctrine buttons, a duplicate BALANCED/SPEED/SCIENCE row and an APPLY ROUTE button that is not visible at 1280x720; the academy tells players to adjust sliders, and choosing a doctrine preset does not advance the power step.
impact_assessment.benefits: The default strip shows only heat, doctrine presets and output; one ECONOMY/OVERDRIVE click completes the power milestone with its reward; manual routing stays available under FINE TUNE.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: reactor tutorial progression and UI layout; dependency: none; concurrency: engine lock held; state: no new save field; regression: route_power and slider apply must still work and not double-award.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first engine test, one-click browser play with a second mode change, fine-tune open/close check, vision review, UI snapshot and full gates.

checkpoints.description: Reactor preset-first verified: 275->242px default, one-click academy step, second mode no double award; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-reactor-preset-first' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: keep four core combat actions visible and move secondary tactics plus subsystem targeting behind SHOW MORE TACTICS

impact_assessment.why: The hostile-intercept card exposes nine actions and four subsystem buttons at once and reaches 713px; at 1280x720 the capped card pushes the disclosure and lower controls below its scroll edge, and the generic TARGET SUBSYSTEM button duplicates the specific controls.
impact_assessment.benefits: Combat starts with four clear choices, secondary tactics stay one click away, the card fits 720p without offscreen controls, and the duplicate path is removed while engine parity remains.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: combat UI and intended removal of btnCombatTarget; dependency: none; concurrency: engine lock held; state: hidden attributes only; regression: board/gambit/PDC/drone/subsystem actions must stay reachable and fire must still resolve.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static disclosure test, 1920 and 1280 combat plays with an actual fire action, vision review, ui allow for the duplicate removal, and full gates.

checkpoints.description: Combat condensation verified: 13->5 controls, 713->564px at 1080 and 442px at 720, fire still hits; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-combat-tactics-disclosure' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: show unlocked ability chips plus a LOCKED count disclosure, and prove all six academy steps in a real browser

impact_assessment.why: The powers strip shows six chips while two are still locked; onboarding has not been played end-to-end after the reactor/combat condensation, and arrival/anomaly cards can cover the academy hint.
impact_assessment.benefits: The default ability strip shows only four usable powers with the locked count one click away; the academy is proven from step 0 through graduation with visible controls and completion recorded at every step.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ability strip and notification placement; dependency: none; concurrency: render stays synchronous; state: locked-open UI flag only, no save field; regression: locked chips must remain reachable and count must update when abilities unlock.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static disclosure test, six-step real-browser play with step/completion assertions, vision review, UI snapshot and full gates.

checkpoints.description: Unlocked-first abilities and academy play verified: 4 chips + LOCKED 2, all six steps to graduation, cards below ribbon; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-locked-abilities-academy' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: make the radar target dossier summary-first with details and rare actions disclosed

impact_assessment.why: At 1280x720 the selected-target card is 249px tall but its content is 314-507px in every state, so the 11-field stat grid clips mid-row and the primary actions (including BOARD DERELICT) sit below the internal scroll edge; system/captain/point states also fill the grid with placeholder dashes.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every selected target shows four key-stat chips and its primary actions above the fold without scrolling, full stats and salvage stay one click away, and rare actions appear only when they apply.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: target dossier UI; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: disclosure DOM flags only, no save change; regression: transit, land, board, jump, hail, salvage strategy and scoop must remain reachable and functional.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static condensation test, multi-state browser play with real quantum transit and salvage strategy selection, before/after measurement, vision review, UI snapshot and full gates.

checkpoints.description: Target dossier verified: every collapsed state fits 246px with zero offscreen actions, details reveal 11 stats, MORE ACTIONS reveals scoop; checklists: passed

handoff.next: commit ADR-203 and target dossier proof

checkpoints.description: Task 'voidfarer-target-dossier' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: lead surface operations with a site strip and one selected RUN card, with map and catalog disclosed

impact_assessment.why: The landed surface panel renders a 205px map plus nine 46-51px rows (714px) inside the 246px target card, so the map fills the whole viewport and no operation name, reward or RUN button is visible without scrolling.
impact_assessment.benefits: The default surface view shows all nine sites as compact chips and the selected operation with risk, rewards and RUN above the fold; the map and full nine-row catalog stay one click away.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: surface operations UI; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: disclosure flags and selected-site UI only, no save change; regression: map selection, direct RUN rows, used-state marking and the full catalog must stay reachable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static condensation test, real-browser play covering selection, map/list reveals, a successful operation and the worked state, before/after measurement, vision review, UI snapshot and full gates.

checkpoints.description: Surface ops verified: 714->188px default with RUN above the fold, map/list reveals, real survey +180 cr and 1/9 worked; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-surface-ops' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: make EMPIRE a headline deck for research, outposts and faction leaders, with catalogs disclosed

impact_assessment.why: EMPIRE is 2665px: research 573px, outposts 210px and faction leaders 1733px all render at once; nine leader rows with six or seven buttons squeeze names into unreadable columns at the 290px docked width.
impact_assessment.benefits: The tab becomes a 402px deck with three headlines, live counts and one-line summaries; project, outpost and faction catalogs stay one click away; diplomacy rows become readable cards.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: EMPIRE left-tab UI; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: disclosure attributes and summaries only, no save change; regression: research START/QUEUE, outpost build, diplomacy actions and all counts must stay reachable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static condensation test, real-browser play of all three reveals plus a research START, before/after measurement, vision review, UI snapshot and full gates.

checkpoints.description: EMPIRE verified: 2665->402px with all headlines visible, research START works, outpost/faction reveals readable; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-empire-condense' completed successfully.
